title: Youkstetter’s, the porkbutcher’s
html_source: What used to be Youkstetter’s Butcher House later became The Cheese Pantry Restaurant, and in 2014 the name changed to Restaurant 104. It is located in the heart of Drumcondra Village in Dublin.
